description:
Overview 
 
 Who we are 
 
 Collaborative. Respectful. A place to dream and do. These are just a few words that describe what life is like at Toyota. As one of the world’s most admired brands, Toyota is growing and leading the future of mobility through innovative, high-quality solutions designed to enhance lives and delight those we serve. We’re looking for talented team members who want to Dream. Do. Grow. with us.
 
 An important part of the Toyota family is Toyota Financial Services (TFS), the finance and insurance brand for Toyota and Lexus in North America. While TFS is a separate business entity, it is an essential part of this world-changing company- delivering on Toyota's vision to move people beyond what's possible. At TFS, you will help create best-in-class customer experience in an innovative, collaborative environment.
 
 

 Toyota does not offer support or sponsorship of job applicants for employment-based visas or any other work authorization for this role now or in the future. You must have the right to work in the United States and not require Toyota support or sponsorship for immigration-related employment (e.g., H-1B, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, TN, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, ‘job flexibility benefits’ [also known as I-140 or Adjustment of Status portability], etc.) now or in the future. You should not apply for this role if you will require Toyota to assist with immigration support or sponsorship now or in the future. 
 
 Who we’re looking for 
 We are seeking a motivated Snowflake & Analytics Platform Engineer  to support the design, administration, and optimization of our Snowflake data platform and analytics ecosystem. This role will help maintain a secure, scalable, and reliable environment that supports reporting, visualization, and business intelligence tools such as Tableau  and future-generation BI platforms such as AWS QuickSight .
 
 The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience or strong foundational knowledge in Snowflake platform support, analytics tooling, access management, and data platform operations . This role will work closely with data engineering, analytics, security, and business teams to help improve platform usability, governance, performance, and adoption.
 
 What you’ll be doing 
 Support the administration, maintenance, and optimization of the Snowflake platform across development, test, and production environments

 Assist with managing Snowflake warehouses, databases, schemas, roles, and access permissions following established standards and best practices 

 Help monitor platform performance, usage, and cost to support efficient and reliable operations 

 Contribute to platform security and governance activities, including role-based access control, user provisioning, and access reviews 

 Support user onboarding tasks such as account setup, access requests, documentation, and general platform enablement 

 Assist in developing and maintaining documentation, standards, and operational procedures for Snowflake platform usage and support 

 Work with analytics and reporting teams to support visualization tools such as Tableau and future BI capabilities such as AWS QuickSight 

 Help troubleshoot platform, access, and performance issues across Snowflake and connected analytics tools 

 Participate in observability, audit readiness, and operational monitoring efforts to improve platform reliability and compliance support 

 Collaborate with data engineering, analytics, and infrastructure teams to support platform improvements and broader adoption 

 Contribute to best practices for data platform operations, support processes, and reusable patterns 

 Stay current on new Snowflake features and analytics platform capabilities, including emerging AI-enabled and BI capabilities where relevant 

 
 What you bring 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

 Experience working with Snowflake  in an engineering, support, analytics, or platform administration capacity 

 Familiarity with data visualization and BI tools such as Tableau , with exposure to AWS QuickSight  considered a plus 

 Understanding of core data platform concepts including databases, schemas, roles, compute warehouses, and data access controls 

 Knowledge of platform security concepts such as RBAC , least-privilege access, and user access management 

 Basic to intermediate SQL skills for troubleshooting, validation, and support tasks 

 Experience with monitoring, usage analysis, cost awareness, and operational support in a cloud data environment 

 Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot technical issues across platform and user support areas 

 Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes and work effectively with cross-functional teams 

 
 Added bonus if you have 
 Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS 

 Experience supporting analytics user communities or business intelligence platforms 

 Familiarity with data governance, audit support, or compliance-related operational processes 

 Awareness of emerging BI, AI, or agentic capabilities within Snowflake or modern analytics platforms 

 
 What we’ll bring 
 During your interview process, our team can fill you in on all the details of our industry-leading benefits and career development opportunities. A few highlights include:
 A work environment built on teamwork, flexibility, and respect

 Professional growth and development programs to help advance your career, as well as tuition reimbursement

 Team Member Vehicle Purchase Discount

 Toyota Team Member Lease Vehicle Program (if applicable)

 Comprehensive health care and wellness plans for your entire family

 Toyota 401(k) Savings Plan featuring a company match, as well as an annual retirement contribution from Toyota regardless of whether you contribute (if applicable)

 Paid holidays and paid time off

 Referral services related to prenatal services, adoption, childcare, schools and more

 Tax Advantaged Accounts (Health Savings Account, Health Care FSA, Dependent Care FSA)

 Relocation assistance (if applicable)

 
 Belonging at Toyota 

 Our success begins and ends with our people. We embrace all perspectives and value unique human experiences. Respect for all is our North Star.

 Applicants for our positions are considered without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, religion, military or veteran status, or any other characteristics protected by law.

 Have a question, need assistance with your application or do you require any special accommodations? Please send an email to talent.acquisition@toyota.com .
